entities.name: Mosque of the Prophet Shith
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Al-Nabi Shith Mosque was a historic mosque and shrine in Mosul, Iraq. The shrine is believed to contain the tomb of Seth, third son of Adam, known by Muslims as Sheth or Shith. Destroyed by ISIL following the Fall of Mosul in 2014, there were plans to rebuild the mosque.
